description: Different model profiles should preserve top project findings, blocker visibility, and high-value missing coverage in a polyglot repository.

lockedFields.reason: The top findings report should not downgrade coverage when all detected projects are audited.
The polyglot fixture should keep two blocker findings and three missing-coverage findings visible.
The low-confidence Python service should keep both blocker reasons visible in top findings.
The top findings report should preserve the count of high-value untested recommendations.
The top findings report should preserve blocked-project visibility in summary counts.
Blocked projects should outrank target recommendations when the audit cannot fully trust a project.
The blocker should stay attached to the Python service project root.
High-value untested targets should remain distinct from blocked-project findings.
The Kotlin checkout target is the highest-priority missing coverage recommendation.
The web service-boundary recommendation should remain visible after higher-priority findings.
